item.description: On International Women's Day 2026, we celebrate the vital role women play in Scouting, from leaders to volunteers. Their dedication empowers young people, fosters equality, and shapes a more inclusive world for all.

item.title: LTAF - An Unforgettable Hike on the Cooloola Great Walk | Scouts Australia
item.description: A Patrol of four Venturer Scouts and two Leaders from Scouts ACT embarked on an unforgettable adventure - the Cooloola Great Walk. This ambitious expedition, made possible with the generous support of the Dick and Pip Smith Leadership Through Adventure Fund (LTAF), challenged the Scouts to push their limits, build resilience, and grow stronger together as a Patrol.

item.description: South Australia Venturer Scout and Patrol Leader, Harry, undertook an ambitious and rewarding expedition completing Tasmania’s challenging South Coast Track.
